title: Emaar India — Depth & Specificity Research
content:
Emaar India's flagship projects include Urban Ascent, Urban Oasis, DigiHomes, Palm Gardens, Marbella Villas, Serenity Hills, The Palm Drive, and Emaar The 88 in Gurgaon. Other notable projects are Emaar Business District, Emaar Continental City, Palm Hills, Jaipur Greens, Mohali Hills, Capital Towers, Marbella, Emerald Hills, The 88, Emaar Business Centre 75A, Emerald Estate, DigiHomes, and EBD 65. Ready-to-move projects include Emaar The Esplanade, Emaar Commerce Park, Emaar Sky Terraces, Emaar Mohali Hill Villas, Emaar MGF Palm Studios, Emaar MGF Garden Terraces, Emaar EMAAR MGF Mockup Villas, Emaar MGF Downtown Capital Tower 1, Emaar The Avenues, Emaar Grace, and Emaar MGF The Meadows.

Many Emaar properties are positioned near major business districts, highways, educational institutions, and commercial hubs, making them relevant for both residential living and long-term real estate exploration.

Q: Is Emaar India still a joint venture with MGF?

No. Emaar Properties ended its joint venture with MGF Developments on April 11, 2016, through a court-approved demerger. Emaar India has operated as an independent, standalone developer entity since then.

### Emaar Business District Portfolio

Emaar India targets premium and luxury residential segments, focusing on Golf Course Extension Road and Dwarka Expressway in its projects. Geographically, it has a significant presence in Gurugram and is expanding into other Indian markets. Emaar India operates under the global Emaar brand and has a long-standing presence in the Indian real estate market, with a portfolio of delivered projects and community-management operations. The company is also exploring potential expansion into Mumbai to diversify its geographic footprint.

Emaar plays primarily in premium and upper-middle residential development, mixed-use urban districts, destination retail, commercial leasing, hospitality, and leisure. Geographically, it plays most heavily in Dubai and the wider United Arab Emirates, which remain the economic core of the company. Outside the UAE, Emaar plays more selectively through established platforms, especially in Egypt and India. Its customer scope is broad but related: residential buyers, real estate investors, retail [...] | Key products or services | Residential property development, mixed-use master-planned communities, retail and commercial leasing, shopping malls, hotels, serviced residences, leisure and entertainment destinations |
| Geographic footprint | Primarily United Arab Emirates, especially Dubai, with selected international operations including Egypt and India | [...] Outside the UAE, Emaar has maintained selected international development platforms. Egypt is one of the most important, with a long-standing presence through Emaar Misr. India is another key international market through Emaar India. Emaar has also had exposure to other markets in the Middle East, North Africa, and South Asia over time, though the company’s public narrative in recent years has been more disciplined and selective than globally expansive.

## Why Buyers Still Consider Emaar — Four Honest Reasons

### 1. The Parent Brand Still Means Something

Emaar Properties built the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Mall that design pedigree shows up in Emaar India’s clubhouse and common-area specifications, consistently above the Gurgaon mid-luxury average.

### 2. The MGF-Era Baggage Is Actually Resolved [...] The 2016 demerger was a full legal separation, court-approved, giving Emaar India a clean independent structure. Projects launched since then carry their own HRERA registrations with no joint-venture ambiguity behind them.

### 3. The Golf Course Extension Road Concentration

Emaar’s Gurgaon portfolio sits almost entirely inside Sectors 61 through 66 genuine scale advantages in amenities, security, and estate management shared across projects a few kilometres apart.
